newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end higher after paring gains on rate comment.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end higher after paring gains on rate comment.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGB futures ended sharply higher, but pared some earlier gains in the afternoon after LDP official said he sees a chance of a credit tightening by early autumn. *But overall sentiment strong, as expectations of an imminent credit tightening eased after Thursday's output data.
